mapper.sql: id, scenic_area_id, route_name, route_type, suitable_crowd, duration_minutes, distance_meters, description, recommended_reason, status, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select from tour_route where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 limit 1
select from tour_route where id = #{id} and status = 1 and deleted = 0 limit 1
select from tour_route where scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} and status = 1 and deleted = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc

select tr.id, tr.scenic_area_id, tr.route_name, tr.route_type, tr.suitable_crowd, tr.duration_minutes, tr.distance_meters, tr.description, tr.recommended_reason, trg.geojson, trg.version as geo_version from tour_route tr left join ( select a.route_id, a.scenic_area_id, a.geojson, a.version from tour_route_geo a inner join ( select route_id, scenic_area_id, max(version) as max_version from tour_route_geo where status = 1 group by route_id, scenic_area_id ) b on a.route_id = b.route_id and a.scenic_area_id = b.scenic_area_id and a.version = b.max_version where a.status = 1 ) trg on tr.id = trg.route_id and tr.scenic_area_id = trg.scenic_area_id where tr.scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} and tr.status = 1 and tr.deleted = 0 order by tr.create_time desc, tr.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into tour_route ( scenic_area_id, route_name, route_type, suitable_crowd, duration_minutes, distance_meters, description, recommended_reason, status, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{scenicAreaId}, #{routeName}, #{routeType}, #{suitableCrowd}, #{durationMinutes}, #{distanceMeters}, #{description}, #{recommendedReason}, #{status}, #{deleted}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update:

scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId},
